title: Mathematically optimized cryoprotectant equilibration procedures for cryopreservation of human oocytes
license: CC BY 2.0, as stated in article

locators.equations: Methods, bmcM1,bmcM2,bmcM7; Appendix bmcMA1,bmcMA8 in XML
locators.parameters: Methods, paragraphs immediately following Eq1 and Eq2

state_units.s: intracellular CPA moles / isotonic intracellular solute moles
state_units.m1,m2: extracellular nonpermeant and CPA molality normalized to 0.3 Osm/kg
state_units.s/w: intracellular CPA molality normalized to 0.3 Osm/kg
state_units.relative_volume: source-defined w+gamma*s, not water volume alone

qualification: Equation/parameter implementation with independent transformed-system numerical reference. No source optimization reproduced; no measured curve digitized or independently validated.
limitations: Human oocyte ethylene glycol at 22 C, not iPSC or other CPA calibration.
Isothermal fixed bath steps; no cooling, ice growth, toxicity or survival response.
Exposure integral is reported in Osm min/kg, without the paper toxicity exponent or a fitted damage rate.
Schedules and sensitivity factors are analyst-designed virtual comparisons, not published protocols or laboratory instructions.
Generic staged loading is established prior art.
